decode_video: decode a video file using pyav or torchvision backend with temporal sampling and frame extraction
sample_temporal_frames: sample evenly spaced frames from a video tensor between given start and end indices
compute_clip_indices: compute start and end frame indices for uniformly or randomly sampled video clips
compute_multiple_clip_indices: compute start and end frame indices for multiple clips with configurable min and max delta spacing
decode_with_pyav: decode video frames from a pyav container with selective or full video decoding based on clip parameters
